verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page lists 'Clips, playlists + search across calls' and 'Playlists of highlights from meetings', so the product documents its own clip and highlight capability. The evidence is only one-line marketing bullets: nothing describes how a clip is cut, and nothing confirms that a clip can be shared as a standalone link instead of the full recording. Missing for 10: documentation of the clip-creation workflow, explicit sharing of individual clips or highlights, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
